description: This file defines the SerializerSessionPool class used for managing pooled SerializerSession objects within the Orleans serialization framework. It includes methods for acquiring and returning sessions, as well as defining the pool's internal policies.

classes.name: SerializerSessionPool
classes.description: A pool managing SerializerSession instances for efficient reuse during serialization processes.

classes.name: SerializerSessionPool.SerializerSessionPoolPolicy
classes.description: Defines the creation and reset policy for SerializerSession objects within the pool.

methods.name: SerializerSessionPool
methods.description: Constructor initializing the session pool with specified codecs and type collections.

methods.name: GetSession
methods.description: Retrieves a SerializerSession instance from the pool.

methods.name: ReturnSession
methods.description: Returns a SerializerSession instance back to the pool.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new SerializerSession according to the pool's policy.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Resets a SerializerSession and indicates it can be pooled again.
